publications.title: The Man Who Needed Everyone to Envy Him
publications.premise: The Man Who Needed Everyone to Envy Him
publications.logline: A rising architectural curator curates his relationship into an enviable public spectacle, only to realize that holding others in awe has made him utterly untouchable to the woman he loves.
publications.psychological_angle: Craving the envy of onlookers functions as a defense mechanism against the terrifying exposure required for genuine love.
publications.central_contradiction: He believes securing the envy of others will make him feel worthy of love, but the act of seeking envy keeps everyone, including his partner, at an emotional distance.

publications.title: The Baker Who Never Had a Dark Thought #Shorts
publications.premise: In a town where every passing thought can be heard, the kindest man alive lets one honest thought slip, and discovers that a mind which is always listened to may never have been his own.
publications.logline: In a town where every passing thought can be heard, the kindest man alive lets one honest thought slip, and discovers that a mind which is always listened to may never have been his own.
publications.psychological_angle: How constant social observation flattens authentic cognition into an internal performative habit.
publications.central_contradiction: He believes his clean thoughts prove he is a good man, yet those clean thoughts are precisely what prevent him from having an authentic self.
